item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. It will be relatively mild during the day over the region. A cold front is expected to move across the coastal areas of southern China during the day on Sunday. The associated intense winter monsoon will bring cold and very dry weather to the region early next week. It will be very cold in the morning over inland areas. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will become cloudier gradually and remain cool in the middle and latter parts of next week.
